label: The assignment problem
subgoals: Write the cost of each cell in each slot as a matrix
Search for the permutation with the least total cost
Enumerate only for very small windows

label: Polynomial-time solution
subgoals: Keep dual prices so reduced costs stay non-negative
Grow a matching on zero reduced-cost entries
Solve it as a unit-capacity min-cost flow when convenient

label: The gap to greedy assignment
subgoals: Let each cell take its cheapest free slot in order
Compute the greedy cost minus the optimal cost
Use exact assignment on sliding windows inside detailed placement
